    How the index is calculated

    • Models. Wan 3.0 Prime, Wan 3.0, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Gemini Omni Flash 1.1, MiniMax Hailuo / H3, Runway Gen-4.x, Grok Imagine Video 1.5. Nothing else is counted.
    • Price per model. The cheapest current row for that model across every API and credit plan we list, the same pick as the model pages. Rows marked discontinued and promos past their end date are left out. A temporary promo that is still on counts, and it is labelled.
    • Usage assumption. API rows are the vendor's stated $/s. Credit-plan rows are plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ clip length, which assumes every credit you pay for is used. Deal-adjusted prices from Deals are not used.
    • Median and cheapest. The median is the middle of the per-model prices in a tier (the mean of the two middle ones when the count is even). The cheapest is the lowest of them. Those index figures mix plan tiers, resolutions (except the resolution rows) and audio settings, so this page does not add a tier or audio column to the index tables. The model pages list those fields on each underlying row.
    • Resolution tiers. 480p, 720p, 1080p and 4K use the exact resolution on the row. MiniMax Hailuo's 768p, 2K, and rows priced per mode count only under any resolution. A tier is shown when at least 5 models have a price.
    • Order. Only $/s sets the order. Affiliate and partner links never change it.
    • History. Each earlier day uses the last copy of prices.json saved on or before that day, Eastern time, so it shows what VidFare published then. Nothing is filled in between saved copies. A move can come from a vendor price change, a newly added row, or a correction. Vendor price changes are listed on Price changes and counted in the last column of the model table (the 7 days before Nov 26, 2026, and since the start). The last saved catalog before this build is from Nov 25, 2026, 7:29 PM ET (4:29 PM PT).
    • Check dates. Last full check Nov 25, 2026. The per-model prices for Nov 26, 2026 were checked Nov 26, 2026.
